notes.title: First Release
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Folks, we are pleased to announce the first release of Strip Shooter. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894419/6d351c606dc1e05bb778a35b8489e1e6248b7b49.png[/img]

The game is simple but intense, structured on 8 increasingly difficult levels. Achieving three stars on each one of them will unlock a bonus level for you to discover and enjoy. 
Of course we look forward to your suggestions on how to improve the game and what content you would like us to add. 

In particular, we would like to know what do you think about the idea of developing a VR edition of the game. We believe that this kind of games could be even more immersive and enjoyable in Virtual Reality, what's your taker on the matter?

Shall you find any bugs or other kind of problems, please report to us and we'll fix them promptly. Enjoy
